MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

2. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 7

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 30
   C. 90
   D. 42

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 66
   C. 17
   D. 34

6. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

7. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 23.6

8. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31.7

9. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27
   D. 27.6

10. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

11. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

12. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

13. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/2

14. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

15. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

16. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
